title: Using ChatGPT to Teach and Learn English as a Foreign Language: Teachers’ and Learners’ Perspectives
core_idea: Investigate teachers' and learners' perspectives on using AI tools, specifically ChatGPT, for teaching and learning English as a foreign language, employing a mixed quantitative and qualitative design with questionnaires containing closed and open questions.
tldr: Explores perceptions of ChatGPT as an AI tool for EFL instruction and learning using mixed-method questionnaires administered to 52 teachers and 98 learners.
